task:
Shotcut is already open with /home/user/Documents/uhd_project.mlt (currently a 1920x1080 30 fps project). A source video exists at /home/user/Videos/drone.mp4.

Steps:
1. Open Settings > Video Mode > Custom > Add... and create a new custom video mode with resolution 3840x2160, frame rate 30 fps, aspect ratio 16:9, progressive. Select it so it becomes the active project video mode.
2. Import /home/user/Videos/drone.mp4 into the project.
3. Drag drone.mp4 onto the V1 timeline track so it becomes the only clip on the timeline.
4. Press Ctrl+S to save the project.

The saved project at /home/user/Documents/uhd_project.mlt must have a 3840x2160 profile at 30 fps and reference drone.mp4.

verification.description: drone.mp4 is referenced in the project

cli_feasibility.translation: Not feasible via CLI - requires changing project profile through GUI Settings > Video Mode > Custom
cli_feasibility.reason: ❌ CLI-Anything shotcut can create new projects with specified profiles but cannot modify the profile of an existing project. Changing profile requires GUI interaction in Settings > Video Mode > Custom. The MLT XML profile can be manually edited but this is error-prone and not a standard CLI operation.
